summary: Southern Company filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for 35,000,000 2026 Series A Equity Units at a $50 stated amount, an ordinary hybrid capital raise rather than a special situation. Each Corporate Unit bundles a purchase contract plus 1/40 interests in Series 2026C RSNs due 2031 and Series 2026D RSNs due 2034; coupons and totals are left blank in the preliminary filing. Purchase contracts settle December 15, 2029, obligating holders to buy common stock at $50 in cash, priced against a $93.84 prior close. BofA Securities and Barclays are joint book-running managers, with a 5,000,000-unit over-allotment option and NYSE listing expected under SONN.
